design: Three fresh independent-velocity replicates on one Ubuntu CUDA software environment; historical Mac trajectory remains exploratory
starting_configuration: Shared minim.gro; new gen_vel in each NVT; not independent starting conformations
reference: Shared original NPT endpoint; use original md.tpr when compatible or a validated equivalent generated from npt.gro
analysis_windows: Full 0-11 ns and prespecified 8-11 ns; half-open 1ns windows except final endpoint
metrics: Native CA contact Q with sequence separation>=3, native cutoff8A, threshold1.2x native distance; sensitivity7/9A
statistical_unit: Trajectory (n=3), never individual frames or NMR models
stop_rule: Complete all three 11ns runs and retain all outcomes; optional extension to20ns only applied to all three under recorded separate decision
technical_stop_rule: Stop queue on failed stage; validate actual GPU use and complete checkpoints; no silent CPU fallback or arbitrary maxwarn
